notes.note: Bounded review of the Windows wrapper exit observation change: executeOwnedCommand now requires an observed wrapper exit plus its existing Job/output settlement proof before declaring the owned tree gone when Node does not emit close. Actual exit without Job acknowledgement stays fenced; live wrappers still use exact-handle cleanup. Existing testing, fail-closed cleanup, platform and scoped-verification guidance remains accurate. Focused owner/launcher/settlement/coordinator evidence is 173 passes with four Windows-only skips on macOS; a regression failed before repair. Real desktop-win Node 24.18 canaries failed before repair with inherited output and passed after repair for inherited and piped 16-byte, 64-KiB and 1-MiB output. Hosted Windows Node 24.21 queue acceptance remains separate and NOT_VERIFIED.
